<description>
Adds sandboxing options that `bitcoind` doesn't need to be exempt from, namely kernel/clock/hostname protection, namespace, realtime and SUID restrictions, a socket address family allowlist, and a system call filter and empty capability bounding set.

Also switches the `ExecStartPre` `chgrp` from "!" to "+", since "!" only lifts `User=`/`Group=`, and the new syscall filter and capability bounding set would block it otherwise.
</description>
